title: GET /api/auth/me/fe-permissions reflects the user's actual role bundles (system-tech)
steps:
1. Authenticate as the system-tech user.
2. Hit GET /api/auth/me/fe-permissions.
3. Inspect fePermissions array and viewMode field.
4. Compare against Tech matrix row: WO View only, Lines E (V inherited), Schedule View, Customers View, no parts/invoicing/timesheets, no toggles, WO_PICK_PARTS only sub-setting, viewMode='tech', all cross-toggles OFF.
expected: fePermissions contains: WORK_ORDERS_VIEW, WORK_ORDER_LINES_EDIT, SCHEDULE_VIEW, CUSTOMERS_VIEW, WO_PICK_PARTS — and NOTHING ELSE. viewMode='tech'. crossToggles all false.
